mechanism: Both drugs can cause hypotension and electrolyte disturbances; zoledronic acid may impair renal function which affects tadalafil clearance, and combined vasodilatory effects may potentiate hypotension.
action: Monitor blood pressure and renal function; ensure adequate hydration with zoledronic acid infusion; counsel on hypotension symptoms and position changes; consider dose adjustment of tadalafil if renal impairment develops.
